specs.title: ASHA visit with a danger sign: assistant, urgent finding, confirmation, programme plan and receipts

steps.title: start a visit for the assigned person
the visit assistant extracts fields from the note and the worker reviews them
the worker adds a temperature and saves the draft
the clinical review shows the urgent finding and names the CHC/FRU referral
the visit form as saved
review the recorded facts and confirm the visit
prepare, approve and run the programme plan
receipts: one accepted, one uncertain
look up the uncertain receipt: found, and nothing is sent again
the server records one attempt per destination and two accepted receipts

specs.title: a stranger who opens another organisation is refused, with no patient data and no crash
an invitation code that does not exist is refused with a clear message
an address that is not a page shows a not-found page
owner sees the demonstration protocols and the source library

steps.title: protocols
source library

specs.title: owner sets a name, invites an ASHA by account code and assigns one person; the ASHA sees only that person

steps.title: the owner sees the whole demonstration caseload

the ASHA reads her account code on her own screen
the owner invites her by that code
the ASHA joins the organisation with the invitation code
before any assignment the ASHA has nobody in her visit list
the owner assigns Meena Devi to her
the ASHA now sees that one person and nobody else
the server agrees with the screen

the ASHA menu holds care work only
the server also refuses an ASHA the operations read
